primitives.name: Stage-Fright Induction
primitives.verbatim_quote: Many a first-time track athlete is afflicted with a sensation exactly similar to stage-fright, and wholly unable to do himself or his college justice from this very lack of experience.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\tau_{\\text{fr}}': 'dimensionless threshold parameter for performance degradation', 'E_{\\text{exp}}': 'experience level (unitless normalized scale)'}
primitives.assumptions: Performance degrades nonlinearly with insufficient prior exposure; \tau_{\text{fr}} > 0.

layer2.mapping: Models the cognitive load-induced performance drop in novice athletes via a probabilistic threshold model.
layer2.telemetry: Observed deviation from expected performance metrics in first-time competitors.

primitives.name: Coaching Efficiency Factor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Whenever it is possible, an experienced coach should be employed, for he is even more desirable in track and field events than in foot-ball or base-ball, although perhaps in rowing the services of a coach are of equal value.
primitives.assumptions: \eta_{\text{coach}} is a function of T_{\text{event}}, with higher values for track and field.

layer2.mapping: Maps coaching impact to a scalar efficiency factor across event types via comparative analysis.

primitives.name: Squad Coordination Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: The men should be worked in squads, and it is well to have a sub-captain or man in charge of each of these squads, while the captain himself has full charge over all.
primitives.assumptions: Hierarchical control improves coordination; C_{\text{sub}} \in \{0,1\} and C_{\text{cap}} > 0.

layer2.mapping: Represents squad-based command structure as a layered control graph with local and global authorities.
layer2.telemetry: Squad response time and task completion rate under hierarchical vs. flat structures.
